records.evidence_slice: RBKC Citizens’ Panel – Making the borough safer consultation report (April 2025) publishes ward-level perception of crime. For Campden, the map reports Low 42%, Average 37%, High 21%. The report warns that ward percentages are based on small numbers of Panel members and should be treated with caution.
